result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active unmatched contributors. The `codeanalyzer` test suite passes (330 run, 0 failures, 3 skipped). I did not commit.

**Change** in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`:

- `belongsToUndefinedTeam` was a stub. It compared `ContributorRepositories` members against an email `String`, so it always returned true and every unmatched contributor landed in the remainder. It now returns `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`.
- I dropped its unused second parameter and updated the one call site in `getAllTeams()`.
- The Javadoc now describes the activity rule.

Configured teams are untouched: they still take every matched member regardless of activity. Blank latest-commit dates count as active because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for blank input.

I did not run `mvn install`, so the `reports` module will only pick up this change once `codeanalyzer` is reinstalled.
